verdict: Reserves are $63,087 short of what users are owed (−3.42%), status Needs review. Confirmed or supported causes account for $3; −$63,090 is still unexplained. Open candidates: Staking rewards funded from a wallet outside the lockers (−$31,976); Funds in transit over the Cardano↔Ethereum bridge or an LP withdrawal (−$10,000).

causes.cause: iUSD is counted at a placeholder price
causes.explanation: Reserves include $5,725 of iUSD at a price Strike has not confirmed; if it is worth less, the gap is wider by up to that amount.

causes.cause: Vault accounts hold more (or less) than the sum of their depositors' shares
causes.calculation: Σ vault account equity $1,084,859 − Σ depositor shares $1,084,856 = 3
causes.explanation: Vault money sits in the lockers (reserves) but only depositors' shares are counted as owed, so the difference shows up one-for-one in the gap.

causes.calculation: account equity $729,897 − Σ margin_balance $652,650 = $77,248 isolated margin, already inside equity
causes.explanation: Liabilities use wallet_balance + unrealized_pnl, which already contains the $77,248 held in isolated-margin positions, so nothing is missing (this was the cause of the earlier $77K swing, fixed 23 Oct).

causes.cause: Relayed deposits not counted in reserves
causes.explanation: Deposits from chains without their own locker arrive as USDC in the Ethereum locker via Strike's relayer, and the Ethereum locker balance is counted in reserves. They affect the per-chain flow match, not the ratio.

causes.cause: Commission balances not yet exposed by Strike
causes.explanation: Commission is owed to users, so adding it would widen a shortfall; it cannot explain one.

causes.cause: Open trader profit whose losing side sits outside the lockers
causes.explanation: Users are owed $34,871 of net open profit. The other side of their trades is Strike's market-maker bot on external exchanges, counted as a reserve line of $0. The $34,871 not matched by the bot is a candidate, not a confirmed cause.

evidence.label: Net unrealized PnL owed to users

causes.cause: Staking rewards funded from a wallet outside the lockers
causes.explanation: Staking rewards ($31,976) are counted as owed. If they are paid from a treasury that is not one of the lockers, that wallet belongs in reserves. Open question with Strike.

causes.cause: Funds in transit over the Cardano↔Ethereum bridge or an LP withdrawal
causes.explanation: Strike says up to $10,000 is in transit; that is less than the gap, and it is not yet matched on-chain, so it is not attributed.

next_check: Ask Strike for the market-maker bot's full equity on every venue at the scan time and compare it with net open profit.

recalled.content: iUSD on Cardano (about $5.7K) is counted at a placeholder price of $1 until Strike confirms a price source.

Market-maker bot: Strike's bot 0x6139192a58152932e6f8052ef0de2ad197fb1937 holds the other side of traders' positions on Lighter and Aster. Its equity is a separate, disclosed reserve line. It deposits into the Ethereum locker for Strike account 019d06a7-bcfb-79a9-857e-cd54172ba144.

The -$63K gap on 23 Oct was almost exactly net unrealized trader profit (+$33.7K, losing side not on the leaderboard) plus staking rewards ($32.0K). Open questions: where the counterparty of open profit sits and which wallet backs staking rewards.

Strike stated known in-transit funds: a large LP withdrawal on Ethereum and Cardano USDCx deposits / USDC withdrawals bridged back through the IOG bridge. The engine tolerates up to $10,000 as "In transit"; the transfers are not yet matched on-chain.
